overview_description.description: Interfield Software Solutions is a B2B software company that provides data management, industrial SaaS, and procurement marketplace solutions for industries such as oil & gas, mining, renewables, and maritime. Interfield Software Solutions helps industrial businesses digitize field operations, streamline workflows, and improve operational efficiency through cloud-based platforms and AI-driven tools.

about_short_description.short_description: Interfield Software Solutions provides data management solutions and online-offline software applications for the oil and gas industries.

product.name: Equipment Hound
product.description: A procurement gateway connecting buyers and suppliers globally in industries like Oil & Gas and Mining, offering a marketplace for both new and surplus industrial equipment.

product.name: ToolSuite
product.description: A cloud-based platform that digitizes field tickets and job reports, offering real-time operational data management and workflow streamlining for industrial companies.

product.name: MineSuite
product.description: Provides a consolidated, real-time view of mining operations, including activity reports and financial data, to support informed decision-making.

product.name: ESG-Suite
product.description: A platform based on ESG principles that enables companies to track and report on environmental, social, and corporate governance standards across all sectors.

product.name: Apollo
product.description: A modular operational software platform designed for providing operational insights through various modules and sub-modules, focusing on AI and machine learning.

product.name: Data Management Software
product.description: A suite of software solutions for digitizing reporting processes, streamlining operations, and generating customized management reports.
